data.text: APPROVED: (1) Clone Service w/ mutated selector — TestWorktreeCloneStamping asserts sancho-wt-feat-auth Service selector worktree=feat-auth, stable Service selector stays {app: sancho}, 4 Deployments (stable+clone x2) applied; cluster DNS <svc>-wt-<worktree> reaches only worktree pods by construction. (2) Env/arg rewrite in clone entities — TestWorktreeSiblingDNSRewrite: cache->cache-wt-feat-auth, cache:6379->cache-wt-feat-auth:6379, cache.default.svc.cluster.local->cache-wt-feat-auth.default.svc.cluster.local; shared sibling stays bare (postgres has no workload clone -> DB_HOST=postgres, no postgres-wt-feat-auth applied); scheme'd URL (postgres://user@postgres/db) and literals untouched. TestWorktreeSiblingDNSRewrite_Args: --cache-host cache -> cache-wt-feat-auth, --db-host postgres stays. (3) Selector uniqueness — stable Deployments keep bare selectors, no worktree label/annotation; shared sancho-config never cloned. (4) One-way invariant — TestWorktreeSiblingDNSRewrite_StableUntouched: stable api keeps env value 'cache'. Impl review: rewriteSiblingRefs at end of stampWorktreeClones (complete clone set), annotation+CutSuffix gate on Service clones, ExtractPods returns in-object pointers so in-place env/arg mutation persists; wired into both apply paths (reconciler.go:438/610). Evidence: go test ./internal/controllers/core/kubernetesapply/ -count=1 -> ok 4.504s (6 worktree tests incl. 3 new rewrite tests, all PASS in -run TestWorktree -v); go test ./internal/k8s/ -count=1 -> ok 6.244s; go vet + gofmt clean. Screenshots N/A (pure Go controller change, no browser surface). Files: .worktrees/tk-kxk/.agents/match/validations/tk-kxk-{evidence.txt,kubernetesapply-tests.txt,k8s-tests.txt,worktree-tests-verbose.txt,vet-gofmt.txt}, committed f9e0ac0e2.
